initial_decision.brief_rationale: The population table establishes an observed risk difference of 0.10. Arithmetic verification does not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R214-1 to assess whether its design information identifies the requested causal effect.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 24/60 − 27/90 = 0.10. R214-1 supplies consistency and no interference but no conditions identifying the missing counterfactual outcomes. Therefore, the average causal risk difference is not uniquely identified.
